name: LanguageWire Translation Provider
description: A TMGMT translator plugin that uses LanguageWire translation services.
project_description:
The LanguageWire Translation Provider module is a Drupal module that integrates with the TMGMT module. It allows users to access LanguageWire translation services, enabling more effective and professional translations.

 Back to top 

 Features 
 
 Content translation 
 
 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 
 Drupal 10/11 
 
 Back to top 

 Installation 
 Composer mode 
 Run the following command to install the module using Composer:

 composer require drupal/languagewire_translation_provider Manual mode 
 
 Download the module from Drupal.org. 
 Extract the contents to the /sites/all/modules directory of your Drupal installation. 
 Enable the module through the Drupal administration interface. 
 
 Back to top 

 Usage 
 
 Go to the translation menu and select "Providers". 
 Create a new provider and enter all the data provided by LanguageWire. 
 Go to the translation menu and select the pages to translate. 
 Add them to the basket and follow the checkout steps.
